# Every reach-in the test suite makes, counted. Generated by
# tests/census/test_reach_ins.py; do not edit by hand.
# Regenerate from vinga-server/ with
# `uv run python -m tests.census.test_reach_ins`.
#
# One line per distinct pair: path  name  sites. No positions, so a
# change that only shifts a line leaves this file alone, while the
# count moves whenever the number of reaches at that pair does. The
# file:line of every site comes from the census itself,
# `uv run python -m tests.tools.reach_ins --by-site`.
#
# This file records what is there. It freezes the census rather
# than endorsing it: a green run means nothing arrived unnamed, not
# that the number is right. The reduction is #531 M3's, after #482
# and #488 M1.
